svg.title: Yeony — Small ideas. Useful possibilities.
svg.desc: Yeony creative tools. A thick, beveled Möbius belt shown at an angle that reveals its half-twist, with its complete material circulating through the fixed twist. Brushed grain, transverse joints, edge stitches and six alternating single-surface yellow inlays move together. One geometric lap takes 8.4 seconds and the complete surface circuit takes 16.8 seconds. Six short face-normal markers rotate around all three local axes: negative X, positive Y, and negative Z. The Z rotation follows the original clockwise orbit in the reference front view. Each axis completes a revolution in 30 seconds.

g.aria-label: A thick Möbius conveyor belt. Its complete material circulates through the fixed twist: brushed grain, panel joints, edge stitches and six yellow inlays all move together along one continuous surface.
